label: Night Shift on Meridian
summary: The station's scheduling system keeps putting you on the night maintenance shift with the same engineer, and nobody can say why.
title: Night Shift on Meridian
description: Six nights in a row the roster has paired you with the same person. The scheduler insists it is random. It is not.

chapterOutlines.title: Shift Change
chapterOutlines.outline: Start another night shift, meet the engineer, notice the pattern.

chapterOutlines.title: The Scheduler
chapterOutlines.outline: Dig into the old scheduling code and who wrote it.

chapterOutlines.title: Planetrise
chapterOutlines.outline: The rare night when Halcyon's rings light the whole station.

scene.location: Maintenance corridor C, outer ring of Meridian Station
scene.summary: 02:00 station time. The corridor lights are dimmed for the night cycle and a coolant pump is making a noise it should not make.

openThreads: Why does the scheduler keep pairing you two?

npcs.name: Dex Arroyo
npcs.description: Knows every pipe on the station by sound and hums off-key while she works.
goals: Get the coolant pumps through one more season
abilities: Can fix almost anything with the wrong tools
